'''Una Poot''' led an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] cell on [[Silver Station]]. She had lost several lovers to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], one of whom was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].
